name: Damage during Incarnation of Chaos locks in a Time Loop (#3684)
contract: Original Pure Chaos 807569 gives all damage a 10 percent chance to apply the three-second Time Loop 807571
only during Incarnation of Chaos 570067. Existing spell_proc flags and the aura condition preserve that
Eight independent Chronomancers normally cast Decomposition 800856 on eight level-80 enemies before opening
one Incarnation window each. Actual periodic damage without Incarnation must produce no Time Loop. Chaos
Fusion 807578 extends the original 15-second parent to 18 seconds; normal mana costs, global cooldowns and
During the parent windows, trained dagger auto attacks and pre-existing enemy DoTs supply at least 200
measured eligible damage events. The checker requires a native Pure Chaos proc, an observed self-cast Time
Loop with its original duration, and automatic Chromatic Shard casts. At the original 10 percent chance,
zero successes in 200 trials has probability 0.9^200, below 1e-9. Every aura sample is less than one second
apart, so a three-second proc cannot fall between checkpoints. No self-damage aura is injected.
